vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-27171
vulnerability.description: zlib: infinite loop in crc32_combine64() and crc32_combine_gen64() when len2 is negative

statements.status_notes: Backport of madler/zlib commit ba829a45 (hand-ported to Debian's zlib 1.2.13 K&R layout) in build/patches/zlib/CVE-2026-27171.patch, built with dpkg-buildpackage. The package keeps Debian's version string on purpose, so scanners still flag it. Proven by test/test_zlib.py: the original hangs on a negative length, this build returns 0. nginx does not call the affected functions.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-42945
vulnerability.description: nginx rewrite module: wrong escaping of a capture and possible buffer overrun

statements.status_notes: Upstream commit 2046b45aa0c6 applied unchanged as build/patches/CVE-2026-42945.patch. Proven by test_cve_2026_42945_capture_unescaping_differs. Neither Trivy nor Grype lists this CVE for any nginx package, so this statement documents the fix but removes no scanner row.
